title: Young Man 1975 High School Portrait, Plaid Suit, Sepia Vintage Snapshot Photo
description: A classic mid-1970s high school senior portrait showing a young man named Paul. He sports iconic 70s feathered hair and wears a bold wide-lapel plaid suit jacket over a dark dress shirt and light-colored necktie. The back of the textured deckle-edged photograph carries a sweet handwritten note to his grandmother dated 1975.
